## Workload

Lena Fischer recorded 489 reads during 277 hours of grading activity. This represents an average rate of 1.8 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the time available and the established session pattern. The record provides a clear summary of the volume completed and the corresponding hourly rate.

## Quality

A further 35 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 68.6 per cent. This outcome was considered alongside the workload information to provide a balanced review of performance. The current session pattern was retained following discussion between the grader and reviewer. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
